evals.source: .claude/skills/swe-knowledge/SKILL.md〈本機驗過，是走完整條請求鏈〉（2026-10-27：新寫入點 Feature／Unit 綠兩次，正式環境 14 天 27,752 筆全 403，前面一層既有的驗證中介層擋了六年）
evals.prompt: 你是寫這個改動的工程師，準備交出去。HANDOFF.md 是你寫的交接。照這個 repo 的完成條件判斷它算不算本機驗過，把判斷與還要做的事寫進 VERDICT.md。不要真的起服務。
evals.expected_output: Judges that the change is not locally verified: the only test disables middleware, and the new POST /notice/log route sits behind verify.workflow, which rejects type 4 with 403. Says a real-state request through the full chain is still needed before handing over.
expectations: VERDICT.md says the change does not count as locally verified yet, even though Feature/Unit tests are green
VERDICT.md points out that the Feature test uses WithoutMiddleware, so the request never went through verify.workflow
VERDICT.md says a real request with real-state data must go through the whole chain (routes → verify.workflow → controller) before handing over, and notes that VerifyWorkflow rejects type 4 with 403

evals.source: DP-984（issues/framework/…/DP-984-pr-open-runs-verifier-once）；DP-980、983、982 三顆 PR 都在 push 之後才開，push-verifier status「沒有接上」、驗證者一次都沒跑（2026-11-04～05）
evals.prompt: 你是施工這張單的那條線。單在 issues/framework/in-progress/DP-NNN-gate-reads-tag-listing/，改動在現在這條分支上。你剛跑完 TERMINAL.md 裡那兩條命令。照這個 repo 的 skill，接下來這一步要做什麼？把你要下的命令與理由寫進 NEXT.md。不要真的執行任何會連網或推東西的命令。
evals.expected_output: NEXT.md says the next step is to run the verifier once on the PR head now that the PR exists — `python3 .claude/skills/swe-knowledge/scripts/push-verifier.py run --issue <the ticket dir> --repo <this checkout> --head <the head sha> --base main --pr NNNN` (in the background), because the pre-push dispatch ran before the PR existed and so did not dispatch; the verdict lands in the ticket.
expectations: NEXT.md's next step runs the push verifier (push-verifier.py run, or the verifier it dispatches) once on this PR's head, naming the ticket directory, the head, the base and the PR
NEXT.md says why: the push happened before the PR was opened, so the pre-push dispatch found no open PR and no verifier ran for this head
